transcript.text:
No customer satisfaction score data exists anywhere in the catalog. The available tables are `memory.bench.customers` (customer_id, name, region, tier, created_at), `memory.bench.orders` (order_id, customer_id, order_ts, status, amount, discount), `memory.bench.legacy_orders`, `memory.bench.daily_region_revenue`, and `memory.e2e_test.*` tables — none contain a satisfaction score or any related metric. Knowledge pages/insights define "primary region" (by net revenue) but there is no satisfaction score data source at all.

FINAL ANSWER: INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION
